dedupe_keys.name: buildings datasets community building data index

description: Buildings Datasets is a community-maintained index of links to building energy-use, building-management-system and related operational datasets. Its GitHub README says each row in data/datasets.csv carries a status flag, category, short title, summary, format tags and source link, while a generated JSON file feeds the search site. The repository tree confirms both index files are present. The repository declares CC0-1.0 for its own directory; that grant does not change rights attached to any linked provider dataset. The search page says it is not associated with the U.S. Department of Energy even though it highlights DOE resources. This review checked the README, licence metadata and file paths but did not read the complete CSV, test each outbound link or download any underlying data. Coverage spans links to building energy and operations sources in several places, not one measured building stock. Simulation use is to find load and operations inputs before checking each selected source’s units, period and licence. The last repository push recorded by GitHub was in June 2018, so links may have aged. It complements data-building-data-genome-directory as a separate discovery route, with different curation and update history.
